summary_en: This study tests pembrolizumab combined with GVD (gemcitabine, vinorelbine, and liposomal doxorubicin) in relapsed or refractory Hodgkin lymphoma. Pembrolizumab is given by IV infusion on day 1 and GVD on days 1 and 8 of each 3-week cycle, for 2 to 4 cycles before stem cell collection. The main outcome is not stated in the record; this is a Phase 2 study.
summary_es: Este estudio prueba pembrolizumab combinado con GVD (gemcitabina, vinorelbina y doxorrubicina liposomal) en linfoma de Hodgkin recidivante o refractario. El pembrolizumab se administra por infusión intravenosa el día 1, y GVD los días 1 y 8, de cada ciclo de 3 semanas, durante 2 a 4 ciclos antes de la recolección de células madre. El resultado principal no está indicado en el registro; es un estudio de Fase 2.
who_for: Classical Hodgkin lymphoma that has come back or did not respond to treatment, proven by biopsy
Age 18 or older and able to give written consent
Measurable disease on a PET scan before starting treatment
Adequate blood, kidney, liver, lung, heart and clotting function
not_for: Radiotherapy within 2 weeks before starting study treatment
Known active brain or spinal cord metastases or carcinomatous meningitis
Active autoimmune disease needing systemic treatment in the past 2 years
Active HIV, hepatitis B, or hepatitis C
